\begin{document}
With fermionic Matsubara frequencies $\omega_n = (2n+1)\pi/\beta$, $\beta>0$ and real $\epsilon$,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{\beta}\sum_{n} \frac{1}{(i\omega_n-\epsilon)(i\omega_n+\epsilon)} = -\frac{\tanh(\beta\epsilon/2)}{2\epsilon} .
\label{eq:s}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
